title: fit_col does not truncate when max==1
description: main.rs fit_col(): when max==1, the condition 'chars.len() > max && max >= 2' is false because max >= 2 is false. The else branch returns s.to_string() unchanged, even if s is longer than 1 character. The function's documented contract says the result fits within max columns, but with max==1 a multi-char string is returned untruncated. Trigger: cmd_contacts_list calls fit_col with max=30 and max=25 so in practice max is never 1 today, but the function contract is violated and any future caller with max<2 gets wrong output.
